Christopher Nolan’s 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐎𝐝𝐲𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐲 (𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔) has sparked a massive resurgence of interest in Wolfgang Petersen’s 𝐓𝐫𝐨𝐲 (𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟒).⁣
⁣
As audiences leave theaters wanting to dive deeper into Greek mythology, many are returning to 𝐓𝐫𝐨𝐲 (𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟒), making it one of the most talked-about historical epics again over two decades after its release. Brad Pitt’s Achilles, Eric Bana’s Hector, and Sean Bean’s Odysseus have all found a new generation of fans, while longtime viewers are revisiting the film with fresh appreciation after seeing Nolan’s adaptation.⁣
⁣
Although 𝐓𝐫𝐨𝐲 (𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟒) and 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐎𝐝𝐲𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐲 (𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔) tell different chapters of the same legendary saga, they’re closely connected. 𝐓𝐫𝐨𝐲 (𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟒) ends with the fall of the city and the beginning of Odysseus’ journey home, while 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐎𝐝𝐲𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐲 (𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔) follows the ten-year voyage that comes after. Together, they form an almost seamless cinematic experience, which has inspired countless viewers to watch the movies back-to-back.⁣
